summary: Allstate's nationwide outage is in its fourth day, and the company has not said why. New today: a Wyoming uranium operation shut down after a reported cyber incident. The FBI is still investigating a break-in at its police database. No official source links these events.

events.title: Allstate nationwide website, app and phone outage, now in its fourth day
events.impact: Customers and agents cannot easily reach policies, pay bills or file claims online. Allstate says customers will not lose coverage or be charged late fees. No restoration time has been given.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Allstate has not given a cause. Online talk about AI or layoffs is speculation with no support.

events.title: Wyoming uranium operation halted after cyber incident
events.impact: Peninsula Energy says plant and wellfield control systems were hit. Operations are paused until safety checks finish. Office systems in the US and Australia are said to be unaffected. No restart date.
events.stated_cause: The company calls it a cybersecurity incident. Nobody has said who did it or how. Only one news report seen, based on the company's stock exchange filing.

events.title: FBI investigating break-in at its national crime database
events.impact: Police use this database for warrant checks and stolen property records. It is unclear what was taken, whether records changed, or whether police lost access.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Reports rely on unnamed sources and the FBI has not commented publicly. Nothing ties it to the September FBI jobs portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation software was disrupted. As of Nov 24, USDA had not said if everything is back or if financial data was taken.
events.stated_cause: A USDA official said systems were shut down over a cyber threat and no personal data was lost. No attacker has been named.

events.title: Thanksgiving storm cuts power to more than 836,000 customers
events.impact: Worst hit are Virginia, Maryland and Pennsylvania. FlightAware counted 417 US cancellations and about 1,800 delays. FAA feed also shows a LaGuardia ground stop until 7:30 pm EST, reason listed only as other.
events.stated_cause: Weather. Reuters reports wind gusts of 50 to 70 mph from a coastal storm toppled trees and power lines.

events.title: More tanker mine reports in Strait of Hormuz; Houthis hit Saudi refinery
events.impact: Brent crude traded near 91 to 95 dollars Thursday, depending on contract and time. Analysts say Hormuz traffic is about half of normal.
events.stated_cause: Iran says tankers hit mines. This is not independently confirmed. The Houthis claimed the refinery attack.

events.title: Bitcoin near 60K USD, down about 2-6% on the week
events.impact: CoinGecko 60,581 (+0.7% day, -2.1% week). Coinglass 60,468 (+3.1% day, -2.3% week). Earlier Coinbase snapshot 58,651. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Coinglass cites short liquidations and 453M dollars of ETF outflows on Nov 25. Sentiment is extreme fear.

events.title: US stocks ended Wednesday slightly mixed; markets closed today
events.impact: Nov 25 close: S&P 500 7,182.78 (-0.25%), Dow 50,182.95 (+0.33%), Nasdaq 23,585.80 (-0.62%). US markets are closed for Thanksgiving.
events.stated_cause: Reports point to inflation data, AI profit worries and tariff plans. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported. No trading halts found.

events.title: Officials say mid-November outages (Microsoft, FAA, banks) had separate causes
events.impact: Microsoft 365 was down nearly 24 hours. An FAA nationwide ground stop and bank problems followed. Services are back. Only the officials' statements are new.
events.stated_cause: The Director of National Intelligence told lawmakers these were separate outages tied to maintenance and technical changes, not a coordinated or state-sponsored attack. Microsoft said no cyberattack caused its outage.

events.title: CISA adds 10 more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers Danfoss, HPE Juniper, Mitel and Vates products. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not link the flaws to the FBI, USDA, Allstate or uranium incidents.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows reduced performance on Sites and Services
events.impact: Status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 18:17 UTC today. I found no news report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: Allstate has given no cause. The uranium company says a cyber incident hit its control systems but has named no attacker. The FBI and USDA incidents have no named cause either. The storm and the oil news have clear causes. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: No confirmed sign of a link between incidents. The storm and Allstate outage are being covered widely already.

prep_note: Allstate customers: keep proof of payments and call your local agent for urgent claims. Storm areas: charge phones, keep flashlights handy and check airline apps before traveling. Keep some cash on hand as a normal habit. Use official sources for updates.
